This is the real headquarters of Anti-Entropy, a city established in the subspace, and the members of Anti-Entropy call it "The Ark".

Kiana is now participating in an important meeting in the conference room of the Ark - Anti-Entropy has found signs of a major outpouring Schicksal, and their target is Kiana with Himeko and Theresa teacher a year ago. The investigated island is named "Sangharama".

But after that, Schicksal also went there to investigate, but found nothing. Now Kiana knows from Anti-Entropy that there are relics of ancient times under this island, and this time, Schicksal dispatched again and went straight to Sangharama, and their target must be the underwater fortress.

Even though they knew that this might be Otto's tactic to lead the snake out of the hole, they had to go because it was to help their friend, the middle-aged girl who voluntarily took all the pain for them. In the ruins of the Sangharama Fortress, there is still an area that the doctor has not yet explored, and there may be a prescription for the cure of Kyuusyou hidden there.

description.zh:
这里是逆熵真正的总部，建立在亚空间内的一座城市，逆熵的成员们称它为“方舟”。


      琪亚娜现在正在方舟的会议室中参与一项重要的会议——逆熵发现了天命大举出动的迹象，而他们的目标正是琪亚娜在一年前同姬子和德丽莎老师一起调查过的名为“伽蓝”的海岛。


      但是之后天命也曾去那里调查过，但并未发现什么，现在琪亚娜从逆熵这里知道了，这座岛屿之下有着上古世代的遗迹，而这次天命再次出动直奔伽蓝，他们的目标一定就是那个海底要塞。


      尽管知道这可能是奥托引蛇出洞的计谋，但是她们也不得不去，因为这是为了帮助她们的朋友，那个为了她们而自愿承担一切痛苦的中二少女。伽蓝要塞的遗迹中还有着博士尚未探索完的区域，那里说不定就藏着救治九霄的药方。

     

      在和天命对上之前，得先去和某个家伙道别才行。这样想着，琪亚娜走进了九霄所在的病房。

Ela era a princesa de uma família rica, mas os desastres a atingem um após o outro. Seu pai morreu em um acidente de carro. Sua madrasta a expussou de casa. Sua melhor amiga traiu ela com seu namorado. O pior é que ela mexeu com o herdeiro do Grupo Song, Eryn Song. Ela não podia pagar a dívida, então foi forçada a ser amante de Eryn Song. Mas a vida não ficou mais fácil. A morte do seu filho a fez deixar a família de Song. Muitos anos depois, quando voltou, mudou de nome e se tornou a diretora regional do Grupo V.N.

What’s worse is that she messed up with the heir of Song’s Group, Eryn Song. She couldn’t afford the debt, so she was forced to be the lover of Eryn Song. But life never got easier. The death of her child made her leave Song’s Family. Many years later, when she came back again, she had changed her name and had become the regional director of V.N Group.

description.pt-br:
Num futuro distante, cientistas descobrem que o Sol está entrando em colapso e que sua expansão inevitavelmente consumirá a Terra. Diante da extinção da humanidade, as nações do planeta abandonam todos os conflitos e unem forças em um projeto sem precedentes: transformar a própria Terra em uma nave interestelar.

Milhares de motores planetários são construídos para arrancar o planeta de sua órbita e conduzi-lo através do espaço profundo em direção a um novo sistema estelar.

Enquanto a Terra atravessa uma jornada que durará gerações, a humanidade passa a viver sob condições extremas, enfrentando catástrofes naturais, crises sociais e o peso psicológico de um futuro incerto.

Mais do que uma história sobre sobrevivência, Terra Errante retrata a fragilidade da civilização humana diante da escala implacável do universo.

description.es-la: En un mundo donde coexisten humanos y demonios, Li Chenxiao fundó por sí mismo la Secta Xuanqing, poniendo fin a siglos de conflictos. Pero bajo esa aparente calma, bullía el descontento y la humillación de la raza demoníaca. Qing li, un joven demonio, se infiltró llevando consigo las esperanzas de su pueblo, ocultándose junto a Li Chenxiao, el líder de la Secta Xuanqing, para buscar la oportunidad de as3s*narlo. Así comenzó su doble vida como asistente del líder, trabajando durante el día y tramando un asesinato en secreto, lo que desencadenó una serie de historias disparatadas y divertidas…

description.en: The kind-hearted and quick-witted Lu Zhiyun has to disguise as a male painter to make ends meet and save her aunt. Extremely talented with her ability to forge famous paintings, she gets herself involved with an imperial guard who needs her to collect evidence for an art forgery investigation. Can this odd "collaboration" still stay platonic when the guard discovers that she's actually a woman?

description.en:
This is based on a legend in Ancient China:  
  
Luuzhu (Green Pearl) is a beautiful pearl gatherer from a small Southern village in Ancient China. Due to her family's poverty, she was sold by her parents to be the mistress of the wealthy but abusive and old Lord Hong. However, Fate is not so cruel to the gentle Luuzhu. Just before her marriage to Lord Hong, Luuzhu met a young handsome nobleman named Jilun on the beach at night. Dazzled by Luuzhu's grace, Jilun purchased her from Lord Hong for ten bushels of pearl (a most generous amount at the time). It turned out that Jilun is one of the richest man in Ancient China! However, Lord Sima Lun, who usurped the throne, now desires Luuzhu for her legendary beauty. He is even willing to go to war with Jilun for her! Will Luuzhu become just another plaything for the rich and privileged, or will she avert from that terrible fate? Or perhaps, will her celestial beauty bring woe upon her and her loved ones?
